risks.title: Economic and demand risk
risks.summary: The company is highly exposed to global economic cycles affecting the construction, industrial and service sectors which constitute its customer base
risks.score_rationale: Demand for Graco's products depends on the level of global commercial and industrial activity. Economic slowdowns, recessions, persistent inflationary pressures or financial market turbulence could significantly reduce demand (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to fluctuations in exchange rates, which can impact its sales and earnings, particularly in EMEA and Asia Pacific
risks.score_rationale: A significant number of routine transactions are conducted in foreign currencies. Variations and volatility in exchange rates have impacted and will continue to impact revenue and earnings (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply chain and cost risk
risks.summary: The company faces pressure on product costs and tariffs ($14M in 2025) that could impact its operations and margins
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks of supply chain disruption and rising production costs, including tariffs directly impacting gross margins (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical risk
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to geopolitical risks that could impact its multinational operations and global sales
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally and is exposed to geopolitical risks including international conflicts and tensions affecting its supply chains and markets (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Market and construction risk
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to continued softness in global construction markets, particularly impacting the Contractor segment
risks.score_rationale: Persistent weakness in residential and non-residential construction markets directly affects the Contractor segment, which represents 48% of revenue (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intellectual property risk
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks of infringement of its intellectual property, which could impact its competitive advantages
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in technology-driven areas requiring intellectual property protection, exposed to risks of infringement and counterfeiting (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Acquisition integration risk
risks.summary: The company pursues an acquisition strategy involving operational and financial integration risks
risks.score_rationale: Graco executes strategic acquisitions ($123M contribution in 2025) with risks related to integration and realization of expected synergies (default score, to be refined)
